notes: The split uses an observation-derived unit phase, the mean and zero-sum chirp components, and absolute FFT bin <=32 versus >32.
Norm-only uses true normalized per-component energies and existing within-component direction. If the existing direction is absent on reference support, keep the original correction on that packet.
Direction-only retains the original per-component norms; all fixed-energy rows retain original total center norm. Exact center is an unconstrained diagnostic.
Keep the frozen half native edges for all intervention arms. Clean preserves frozen readout. E104 per-row normalization stays unchanged.
This evaluation creates no new checkpoint and opens no target files. It is separate from both ongoing formal Full runs.
Supersedes the failed r01 checkpoint smoke. Use the existing buffer/DLPack paths and cast complex128 apertures to complex64 before the tensor boundary.
